messages:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — MediWell wants to convert the POC to a paid order, they sent a PO but the signer chain is mismatched.
Mia (Sales): They returned PO but it only lists Purchasing Manager as signer; their legal insists MSA needs CFO signature for HIPAA workloads.
Devon - Procurement: We need the official PO number + billing contact. Also they're asking for net-60 which our default is net-30.
Sam L (Legal): Uploaded initial redlines. Big items: HIPAA appendix added by customer, tighter liability cap, audit and BAA language. DPA needs updates for encryption and key control.
Alex K: I attached the draft order form (line items unchanged). Customer asked to waive the onboarding/training fee as a condition of go-live.
Mia (Sales): Can we provide a one-time credit for training? Propose 20% credit to close — will that be acceptable operationally?
Sam L (Legal): Legal okay with a one-time commercial credit; any concession >$20k needs Exec approval. On the MSA: SLA tweaks — they asked to bump to 99.99 for dedicated, we want to keep 99.9 with credit caps.
docusign-bot: Envelope 0x33 created and sent to purchaser@mediwell.com for signature (status: sent)
Devon - Procurement: FYI customer requires HSM/KMS mention in orderform and wants KMS key ownership clarified in DPA. Is our standard KMS wording sufficient?
Sam L (Legal): We should mention customer-managed keys as an option and limit vendor access. I'll add a clause for KMS control and HSM support — keep simple.
Mia (Sales): Confusion: Purchasing will sign PO; CFO will sign MSA. How do we route doc signatures so both are valid and mapped to the same effective date?
Alex K: DocuSign can sequence two signers (PO -> MSA). We just need to map signers in metadata and include executed copies back to billing.
Mia (Sales): @Sam L please confirm redline for the DPA HIPAA BAAs. I need the final to attach before I request countersign from their CFO.
Sam L (Legal): Reviewing now. Question: they want annual audit rights for up to 5 years. Acceptable if limited to SOC2-only scope and with 30-day notice; no open-ended infra audits.
Devon - Procurement: PO# PW-88321, billing@mediwell-payments.com. Net-60 requested but finance may accept net-45 with approval.
Alex K: I'll escalate net-45 to finance exec. Also note: finance needs an invoice flow doc and billing contact in the SOW metadata.
Mia (Sales): Plan: I will 1) finalize orderform with training credit, 2) attach Sam's final redline MSA + DPA, 3) send DocuSign with two signers. Devon confirm PO/billing (done).
Sam L (Legal): I'll post the final redline by EOD and call out the KMS language so procurement can review.
Alex K: Perfect — target to have signed order by EOW. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
